lightingIsotropy.method: Thirty-six-bin land luminance-gradient orientation test after excluding the water mask; 1.0 peak-vs-uniform is perfectly uniform.

terrainFractions.basis: Visual area estimate over non-water land at native source scale.

waterMask.method: Source-specific connected cool-water segmentation seeded across the sea, stream, pool, fall, surf, and wash; dry rune footprint removed.

crown.method: Full-frame manual outer-foliage-width census at native 1254 px, including saplings and every visually distinct crown in overlapping stands; median native width 24 px scaled by 2560/1254.

reviewNotes: The raw generation is square and meets the 1254 px minimum, but is below the preferred 2048 px size.

Visual inspection finds the rune slot meeting the west edge at about 39% down and the east edge at about 52% down rather than the required 50% and 47%; this is a registration defect in the one-call output.
No content retry was made because the packet permits only one edit call unless the result is non-square.
Mechanical lighting and mask checks do not establish visual acceptance.
